name: unfair-refused
about: Alex, Bea and Cal fit together by what they want: Alex's TI-84 to Cal, Cal's iPhone 14 case to Bea, Bea's USB-C charger to Alex. But a $15 charger is below Alex's private $61 floor for a calculator, so his agent says no and that loop never forms. When Dana joins, Cal and Dana make a fair 2-way trade instead. Alex and Bea stay listed.

people.name: Alex Novak
people.says: Have a TI-84, need a USB-C charger. At least $61 for the calculator.
people.reasons: I paid full price for it last year.
